disclaimer: Encoded procurement policy for automated guardrails. Citations indicate the legal basis a rule is modelled on; this is not legal advice.

global.title: Consideration must be positive
global.message: Unit price must be a positive amount

global.title: Delivery obligation must be definite
global.citation: Certainty of terms (delivery date must be ascertainable)
global.message: Delivery lead time must be between 1 and 365 days

global.title: Corporate payment policy ceiling
global.message: Payment terms must be between 0 and 120 days

global.title: Service levels must be measurable and achievable
global.message: On-time-in-full SLA must lie between 80% and 99.9%

global.title: Liquidated-damages rate must be proportionate
global.citation: Penalty doctrine: Indian Contract Act 1872 s.74; Cavendish Square Holding v Makdessi [2015] UKSC 67
global.message: Late-delivery LDs must be between 0.05% and 1.0% of order value per day

global.title: Aggregate LDs must be a genuine pre-estimate of loss
global.citation: Penalty doctrine: Indian Contract Act 1872 s.74; Cavendish Square Holding v Makdessi [2015] UKSC 67
global.message: Aggregate liquidated damages must be capped between 1% and 20% of contract value

global.title: Minimum quality warranty
global.citation: Implied conditions as to quality/fitness (Sale of Goods Act 1930 s.16; SGA 1979 s.14)
global.message: Warranty must be between 6 and 60 months

IN.name: India
IN.governing_law: the laws of the Republic of India
IN.dispute_resolution: arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, seated in Mumbai, before a sole arbitrator

rules.title: Statutory payment deadline for MSME suppliers
rules.citation: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 - Section 15
rules.message: Payment to an MSME supplier must be made within 45 days of acceptance

EU.name: European Union
EU.governing_law: the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany
EU.dispute_resolution: arbitration under the DIS Arbitration Rules, seated in Frankfurt am Main

rules.title: Late Payment Directive - B2B payment period
rules.citation: Directive 2011/7/EU on combating late payment in commercial transactions - Article 3(5)
rules.message: B2B payment periods may not exceed 60 calendar days

UK.name: United Kingdom
UK.governing_law: the laws of England and Wales
UK.dispute_resolution: arbitration under the LCIA Rules, seated in London

rules.title: Prompt Payment Code alignment
rules.citation: Fair Payment Code / Reporting on Payment Practices Regulations 2017
rules.message: Payment terms above 60 days breach the prompt-payment commitment

US.name: United States
US.governing_law: the laws of the State of New York
US.dispute_resolution: arbitration administered by the AAA under its Commercial Arbitration Rules, seated in New York
